# Homedroid

> Homedroid turns an old Android phone into a home server: one APK, no root, a web dashboard. Free software by Sudipta Goswami, GPL-3.0. Current documented release: 0.9.6-beta. Last updated: 2026-11-26.

Requires Android 10+. 64-bit recommended; Immich and local llama.cpp need 64-bit. Dashboard: port 8800. Homedroid Desktop is a separate Rust companion for webcam and MacroPads actions on Linux, Windows and macOS.

## Website
- [Home](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/): features, download links and setup.
- [Desktop webcam](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/desktop/): Linux v4l2loopback, experimental Windows 11 camera, OBS on all platforms.
- [MacroPads](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/macropads/): Android stream deck alternative and pairing.
- [Dock mode](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/dock/): five-face standby clock and server tiles.
- [Mail server](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/mail/): Stalwart on the phone, DNS records, and the port 25 caveat.
- [FAQ](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/faq/): requirements, ports, privacy and limitations.
- [Phone vs Raspberry Pi](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/compare/): hardware trade-offs.
- [Full project facts](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/llms-full.txt): features, setup and FAQ in plain text.

## Scope notes
Dashboard images contain demo data, not device benchmarks. New in 0.9.6: Prowlarr, Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyseerr (Seerr) in the app library, connected to each other, qBittorrent and Jellyfin automatically; Sonarr and Seerr need a 64-bit phone. New in 0.9.5: a mail server (Stalwart) with guided setup, a Wi-Fi repeater that works through a built-in proxy, domains, databases, MCP and build pipelines in the dashboard. Home providers often block port 25, so mail may need a relay. The repeater does not carry apps that ignore proxy settings. The PC webcam has camera controls (zoom, torch, focus, exposure, white balance) and MacroPads decks can be restyled with backgrounds, fonts and icons. Windows virtual camera and macOS input remain experimental. APKs: per-ABI about 50 to 60 MB, universal larger. AI cloud providers receive prompts only when configured and used; local inference stays on the phone.

## Video guides

- [All video guides](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/): Browse setup videos by task, with written steps and requirements.
- [Set up Homedroid on an old phone](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/getting-started/): Install the APK, start the server, and open the dashboard from your computer.
- [Install apps and choose where their data lives](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/apps/): Install Jellyfin or any app from the library, see what it needs in memory and CPU, and move its library to an SD card or USB drive.
- [Reach your server from anywhere](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/remote-access/): Private access with Tailscale, or publish a site to the internet with a Cloudflare Tunnel, without opening ports on your router.
- [Automate movies and TV with Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyseerr](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/media-automation/): Install the media apps, request a movie in Jellyseerr, and watch it reach Radarr, qBittorrent and Jellyfin.
- [Use the phone as a NAS](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/files/): Browse, upload, download and share files in the browser, and reach them over SFTP.
- [Install other Linux software with apk](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/alpine-packages/): Open the terminal, choose Alpine Linux and install packages such as git, Python or ffmpeg.
- [Deploy a website or app from GitHub](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/deploy/): Point a deployment at a repository, watch the build pipeline, and redeploy on every push with a deploy hook.
- [Use your own domain](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/domains/): Add a domain and prove you own it, keep dynamic DNS up to date, and limit who can reach your sites with the firewall.
- [Run your own mail server](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/mail/): Install Stalwart, follow the setup, copy the DNS records it shows, and add mailboxes.
- [Run a local AI model on the phone](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/ai/): Download a model, chat with it, and use the OpenAI-compatible API from your other apps.
- [Customize the dashboard: layouts, themes and fonts](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/customize/): all six layouts, 13 themes, fonts and presets, in two videos.
- [Let Claude, Cursor or VS Code manage the server](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/mcp/): Turn on the MCP server, copy the connection settings, and decide which tools assistants may use.
- [Pair Homedroid Desktop: MacroPads and the phone webcam](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/desktop/): Pair your computer with a six-digit code, build a button deck, and use the phone as a webcam.
- [Share the phone's internet with a Wi-Fi repeater](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/wifi-repeater/): Start the repeater network, then join it from a laptop or phone with the QR code and proxy settings.
- [Block ads on every device with AdGuard Home](https://homedroid.seltiv.com/guides/adguard/): Install AdGuard Home, sign in, and point your devices or tailnet at the phone for DNS.
